name: P.M. Telelinnks Limited
about: P.M. Telelinnks Limited engages in trading of iron and steel products in India. It trades TMT bars, rebars, tower parts, etc. The company was formerly known as Surana Strips Ltd and changed its name to P.M. Telelinnks Limited in October 2009. The company was incorporated in 1980 and is based in Secunderabad, India. P.M. Telelinnks Limited operates as a subsidiary of BSL Infrastructure Limited.
